title: Days of the Week Song (Tiny Sparks original)

chorus.chords: C | C | F | C | C | F | G | C
chorus.lyrics: Sun-day, Mon-day, Tues-day too, / Wednes-day, Thurs-day, me and you! / Fri-day, Sat-ur-day, hoo-ray! / Sev-en days, come sing and play!

karaoke.chords: C | C | F | C | C | F | G | C

monday.lyrics: Mon-day, Mon-day! / Back to school we go!

tuesday.lyrics: Tues-day, Tues-day! / Paint a pic-ture day!

wednesday.lyrics: Wednes-day, Wednes-day! / Mid-dle of the week!

saturday.lyrics: Sat-ur-day, Sat-ur-day! / Play out-side all day!

q1.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q1.lyrics: What comes af-ter Mon-day? / Tues-day! Tues-day!

q2.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q2.lyrics: What comes af-ter Wednes-day? / Thurs-day! Thurs-day!

q3.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q3.lyrics: What comes af-ter Fri-day? / Sat-ur-day! Sat-ur-day!

q4.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q4.lyrics: What comes af-ter Sat-ur-day? / Sun-day! Sun-day!

q5.chords: C | F | G | G | C | C
q5.lyrics: What comes be-fore Wednes-day? / Tues-day! Tues-day!

weekend.chords: Am | F | C | G | Am | F | G | C
weekend.lyrics: Sat-ur-day and Sun-day, / they are called the week-end! / Five school days and two to play, / sev-en days in all, hoo-ray!

slow.chords: C | C | C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G | C | G | C | C
slow.lyrics: Let's say them slow-ly! / Sun-day / Mon-day / Tues-day / Wednes-day / Thurs-day / Fri-day / Sat-ur-day
